name: o-json: build jq from the highlighted shape

actions.label: Resume at a field reference
actions.caption: . inserts items; k selects version and a anchors it in the query. Choose where the next query edit belongs without retyping the existing text.

actions.label: Return a second field
actions.caption: . inserts items; comma, k and . add version as another output. Use a comma when one extraction should return several parts of the document.

actions.label: Remove the previous query token
actions.caption: . writes the selected path; backspace removes that whole reference. Correct the last building step without deleting its characters one by one.

actions.label: Pick a jq function
actions.caption: ctrl+f opens the function picker. Read function names and argument counts before inserting one into the query.

actions.label: Read each array item
actions.caption: ] writes .items[] for the selected array. Work with each record separately instead of the collection as one value.

actions.label: Return to the shape mode
actions.caption: m leaves JQ mode and restores the shape keys. Move or reshape the document again after building a query.

actions.label: Leave JQ with Escape
actions.caption: esc leaves JQ mode. Use it when you want to stop building the query and resume normal structure navigation.

actions.label: Group a query expression
actions.caption: ( opens a grouped expression; . fills it and ) closes it. Keep one part of a larger query together.

actions.label: Collect results into an array
actions.caption: [ opens an array expression; . adds items and ] closes it. Collect several query results into a single JSON array.

actions.label: Build an output object
actions.caption: { opens an object expression; . inserts the selected field and } closes it. Give the output a deliberate set of named fields.

actions.label: Insert the selected path
actions.caption: . inserts .items into the jq line. Build an extraction from the highlighted shape without typing its full path.

actions.label: Start the next query stage
actions.caption: | writes the selected array and a pipe; ctrl+f then length completes the next stage. Count the items flowing through the query.

actions.label: Restore an undone query edit
actions.caption: . inserts a path and u undoes it; ctrl+r restores it. Compare the query before and after an edit.

actions.label: Undo a query edit
actions.caption: . inserts the path; u undoes that query change. Explore a query and step back without altering the document.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
